description: When the traveller says the secure link has not arrived, or asks for another: Vuelo texts it again, to the same number. The first time it resends the same link; after that, once it has been opened, or once it has expired, Vuelo cancels it and texts a fresh one, and only the newest works. Never pass the link on in the chat yourself. At most three links a booking.
name: resend_link
title: Text the Vuelo link again
